name: MPI Volume Rendering (1D/2D Decomposition)
aliases: MPI-based Parallel Volume Rendering with Domain Decomposition
definition: Parallel volume rendering using MPI that distributes a 3D scalar dataset across processes via 1D (row-based) or 2D (block-based) spatial decomposition, with each process independently ray casting its assigned volume chunk and image region.
summary: MPI Volume Rendering partitions 3D data spatially across processes for parallel ray casting, distinguished by its static decomposition over dynamic or interleaved alternatives.
